answer: Each identity commits its task context before a specified drand quicknet round; only after the threshold-BLS pulse is finalized does the protocol derive the challenge and parameters from the beacon output and commitment. A lotus cannot precompute answers, while a vine of automated sybils must incur the same admission and execution costs per identity. Commit-reveal makes the challenge unpredictable in advance and limits bias from selectively withholding unfavorable results.
